The charity recorded a cash-adjusted program expense ratio of <cite id="1">84.0%</cite> in FY2024, which beats the <cite id="1">75% industry standard benchmark</cite> as well as the <cite id="1">83.5% peer median</cite>. rich_narrative.summary: Muslim Aid America provides essential humanitarian relief through efficient fundraising and zakat-eligible programs. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="3">$26,971,910 in total revenue</cite> to support victims of natural disasters, conflict, and extreme poverty across regions like Asia, Africa, and the Middle East. The organization maintains strong fundraising efficiency, spending <cite id="1">$0.04 to raise every $1</cite> in donations. Based on FY2024 filings, the charity recorded a <cite id="1">84.2% program expense Ratio</cite>, while its cash-adjusted program ratio stands at 84.0%. A significant portion of operations relies on non-cash gifts-in-kind, which represent <cite id="3">62% of total revenue</cite>. Muslim Aid America is <cite id="2">zakat-eligible</cite>, serving multiple designated asnaf categories including the poor (fuqara) and needy (masakin). It holds a <cite id="1">Platinum Seal of Transparency</cite> from Candid, though its working capital reserves remain lean at 2.1 months of working capital.
